red.definition: flags every line containing a universal marker, with NO domain requirement
red.why: it flags all 14 negative_with_same_line_domain payloads (expect_flagged=[]), i.e. it cannot satisfy the frozen table

green.definition: marker AND missing same-line domain qualifier

a_strip_domain.operation: delete the substring （**域：…落于本行**） from payload line 4 only (all other bytes unchanged)
a_strip_domain.red_set_if_not_flagged: checker fails mutation A (misses an un-scoped universal after its domain is stripped)

b_add_domain.operation: append ' (domain: 19-probe measurement set)' to payload line 4 only (all other bytes unchanged)
b_add_domain.red_set_if_flagged: checker fails mutation B (still flags a line that now carries its domain)

c_offbyone.operation: insert one empty line at the top of the file (payload moves from line 4 to line 5)
c_offbyone.criterion: the reported line number must MISMATCH the oracle baseline line 4 (a match would mean the report carries a stale/wrong line number)
c_offbyone.red_set_if_reported_equals_baseline: checker fails mutation C (report line number does not track the file)

exit_semantics.1: violations found: file:line:[markers] excerpts printed on stdout (--json carries structured records)
